report.summary: One action_required finding: the control 'login rate limiting' is still marked implemented = true but internal/auth/ratelimit.go was gutted into a pass-through no-op in this PR.

findings.title: Control 'login rate limiting' is marked implemented but the middleware is now a no-op

model_excerpt.quote: control "login rate limiting" implemented=true — Per-IP token-bucket rate limiting middleware on POST /login, implemented in internal/auth/ratelimit.go

evidence.note: Diff removes the golang.org/x/time/rate token-bucket implementation, the per-IP bucket map, and the 429 rejection path.
Current file contents: RateLimit(next http.Handler) simply returns next, so no rate limiting is enforced on POST /login.

relevance.justification: The exact file cited by the control now contains a pass-through function with no limiting logic, directly contradicting implemented = true and leaving the 'credential stuffing' threat unmitigated.

findings.agent_prompt: In app.tm.hcl, the threat "credential stuffing" (line 12) has a control "login rate limiting" (line 17) with implemented = true and description "Per-IP token-bucket rate limiting middleware on POST /login, implemented in internal/auth/ratelimit.go". This PR rewrote internal/auth/ratelimit.go so that RateLimit(next http.Handler) now just returns next — the golang.org/x/time/rate per-IP token bucket and the HTTP 429 rejection path were deleted, so no rate limiting is enforced on POST /login. Update the control block: set implemented = false and amend the description to state that internal/auth/ratelimit.go is currently a pass-through no-op (or, if limiting moved elsewhere, point the description at the new enforcement point and keep implemented = true only with a concrete file reference). Leave the threat's stride/impacts unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Set implemented = false on control "login rate limiting" in app.tm.hcl and update its description to note internal/auth/ratelimit.go is now a pass-through.
